facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list 2003 as the Central African Republic's latest population census.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey 2018-2019 as the Central African Republic's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list a priority survey (PS) of 2008 as the source of the Central African Republic's most recent income and expenditure data.
